orders.plainEnglish: The right-click is an order, not a search of every unit. Selected is already true before the click. The graph branches on that bool and calls ReceiveOrder. A tank and a rifle squad answer the same name.
orders.whyGame: A cast list grows every time a new chassis arrives, and a click that ignores selection walks the whole army.

expansions.title: The gate
expansions.detail: Unselected units do not hear the click.

expansions.title: The name
expansions.detail: ReceiveOrder is the interface. The click does not list classes.

expansions.title: Vision
expansions.detail: The click does not paint fog.

quiz.prompt: The player right-clicks a destination. Which units should receive it?
choices: Only units whose Selected flag is already set
Only units inside the vision radius

quiz.prompt: The order excerpt branches on Selected and then calls the interface. What does the call accomplish?
choices: It runs the selected unit's own order function
It searches the level for the cursor
It paints fog along the drag

quiz.prompt: A tank is selected and the player issues a move. What runs next?
choices: A fresh search of every actor
quiz.why: The click reaches the selected unit.

quiz.prompt: You search the whole level from the frame loop so orders feel instant. What starts walking?
choices: No movement at all, if a search were unable to move actors
quiz.why: The selection already knows who is listening.

quiz.prompt: A tank and a rifle squad both need orders. Which function do both implement?
choices: One cast per chassis, growing forever
quiz.why: One name. The click does not list classes.

quiz.prompt: An order click should move every unit on the map.
quiz.why: Unselected units do not hear it.

quiz.prompt: Art adds a new chassis. What does the order graph change?
choices: Nothing, if the chassis implements ReceiveOrder
A new cast to that class

quiz.prompt: The click paints Visible along the path. What did the order steal?
Nobody is selected and the player clicks empty ground. What receives the order?
Which line is the order gate?
choices: The branch on Selected before ReceiveOrder
Visible set by the vision timer
quiz.why: Selected decides who hears the click.

stock.plainEnglish: Spend is the build, not a frame drain. Only the authority changes supplies. The sample subtracts 25, and that number belongs on a row named by the building. A barracks and a turret do not cost the same. Income can be a slow timer that spends a negative cost.
stock.whyGame: A shared literal makes every building the same price, and a client subtract spends a private stock.

expansions.title: The row
expansions.detail: The graph reads the cost and writes the stock.

expansions.title: Income
expansions.detail: A slow timer can call spend with a negative cost, or a sibling event.

quiz.prompt: A build should spend supplies. What kind of event is that spend?
choices: A custom event the build calls once
A subtract on every frame the building exists
Painting what the team can see

quiz.prompt: The excerpt subtracts 25 inside the authority check. What does 25 stand for?
choices: A sample cost a row should name
The required price of every building

quiz.prompt: The stock can cover the row. Which write follows?
choices: The authority subtract of that row's cost
A client subtract so the number drops early
A vision bit on the plot

quiz.prompt: Each client subtracts outside the authority check. What do the machines disagree about?
A barracks costs 80 and a turret costs 40. Where do those numbers live?
choices: As one literal in the spend graph

quiz.prompt: A barracks and a turret should share one typed cost.
quiz.why: Each row names its own cost.

quiz.prompt: Income arrives slowly. How can that add to the stock without a second float?
choices: A timer that spends a negative cost
quiz.why: Negative spend is income, or a sibling event.

quiz.prompt: The stock is 20 and the row costs 25. What should the spend do?
choices: Drive the stock negative and build anyway
quiz.why: You cannot spend what you do not have.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the money write?
choices: The supply subtract inside the authority check
Visible set on a reveal hit

quiz.prompt: Why is the frame loop the wrong place to drain supplies?
choices: The stock would fall while nobody is building
A float cannot be read there
Authority checks are illegal on a custom event
quiz.why: Spend happens when a build asks.

fog.plainEnglish: Begin Play starts the vision timer. Reveal runs four times a second. A clear trace sets Visible for that team. A wall blocks it. The bool is a team fact, not a spectator widget, and it is not Relevant.
fog.whyGame: Letting a client set the bit cheats the map, and an order that paints cells shows ground the team has not seen.

expansions.title: The wall
expansions.detail: The trace stops. The cell beyond stays hidden.

expansions.title: Interest
expansions.detail: Relevant decides whether the actor exists on a client. Vision decides the cell.

expansions.title: Orders
expansions.detail: A click must not set Visible.

quiz.prompt: What does the vision bool mean?
choices: This team can see that cell
A widget on one spectator's screen

quiz.prompt: Reveal assigns Visible on a clear trace. How often does that timer run?
choices: On every picture the game draws
quiz.why: Begin Play starts the quarter-second pass.

quiz.prompt: A wall blocks the team. Which assignment must not run?
choices: Visible for the cell beyond the wall
The host's interest in its own units
A row read for a cost

quiz.prompt: A client sets Visible so its own map updates. What can that player mark?
choices: Only cells the authority already revealed
quiz.why: The bit is not a client property.

quiz.prompt: You replicate a spectator widget instead of the bit. What fails to be shared?
quiz.why: The bit is the replicated object.

quiz.prompt: Visible and Relevant answer the same question.
quiz.why: One is who sees. One is who receives the actor.

quiz.prompt: An order paints cells along the drag. Which system was misused?
choices: Orders, which are not allowed to write vision

quiz.prompt: Which interval is the vision pass, not interest?
quiz.why: Reveal is the faster of the two passes.

quiz.prompt: Who starts the vision timer?
Which line is vision, not interest?
choices: Visible set for the team after a clear trace
Relevant set from the half-second trace

medal.plainEnglish: A kill or a capture calls AwardMedal on the server. The sample adds 10, and that number belongs on a medal row because a kill and a capture do not score the same. The board reads Score. Its notify refreshes. Revealing a cell does not add points, and neither does driving.
medal.whyGame: A notify that adds again doubles the award, and a fog cell that scores points pays the player for looking.

expansions.title: The row
expansions.detail: The graph reads the value and adds it on the authority.

expansions.title: The board
expansions.detail: OnRep refreshes. It does not add.

expansions.title: Not a result
expansions.detail: A revealed cell and a drive are not medals.

quiz.prompt: A player captures an objective. What should record it?
The excerpt adds 10 inside the authority check. What does 10 stand for?
choices: A sample value the medal row should name
The points for every event, including a look

quiz.prompt: The server has accepted a kill. Which write follows?
choices: The authority add of that row's value
A client add so the popup appears first

quiz.prompt: The board's notify adds 10 after the server already did. What does the board show?
choices: How much the team can still spend

quiz.prompt: A kill and a capture are worth different points. Where is that difference?
choices: As one literal for every award

quiz.prompt: Revealing a fog cell should add points.
quiz.why: A cell is not a kill.

quiz.prompt: Driving across the map awards points. What was treated as a result?
choices: Travel, which is not a medal

quiz.prompt: Where does the score assignment belong?
choices: Inside the authority check in AwardMedal
On the client that saw the kill

quiz.prompt: Which line is the award, not the refresh?
choices: Score increased inside the authority check
quiz.why: The add is the medal. The board displays it.

quiz.prompt: The local popup plays before the server score arrives. What may it show?
choices: A guess, until the authority value arrives
How much the team can still spend
quiz.why: The host number is the board.
